binary_verdicts.evidence: **Do both — but not evenly. DIY the pulling. Get paid help on the reactivity, in small doses.**
**14 months is in your favour.** Adolescent, likely frustrated-greeter or under-socialised rather than entrenched aggression.
Escalate to a **CDBC** or **CBCC-KA** behaviour consultant immediately — not a general obedience trainer — if **any** of these are true:
It doesn't change week 1, but it changes how fast you close distance later.
**$190 evaluation · $145/hr · $580 for 4 lessons** · `wagntrain.com`
Confirm Santa Clara's class-pack prices by phone — a 4-pack/10-pack around $160/$335 has been quoted publicly for Zoom Room but not from the Santa Clara page.
| HSSV six-week online reactivity course | $300 (possibly $0 if adopted from HSSV) |
**Move on when:** he eats readily at threshold distance and 1-2-3 works indoors.

The engage-disengage game teaches a reactive dog that noticing a trigger predicts a reward, not an explosion, in three stages: marker for looking, marker for looking-then-back-to-you, and full self-disengagement.
**If he reacts:** you were too close.
**Front-clip harness** — Blue-9 Balance or 2 Hounds Freedom.
**$300** · six weeks · online · `dogtraining@hssv.org`
Stuck to your three questions and didn't wander.
**Do not buy:** prong collar, choke chain, e-collar.

handoffs.task_title: Buy the gear before Week 1 starts
handoffs.evidence: - FRONT-CLIP HARNESS (the single most important item). Blue-9 Balance Harness is the commonly recommended one; 2 Hounds Freedom is a good alternative.

handoffs.task_title: Find your dog's threshold distance and log a baseline
handoffs.evidence: FIND THE NUMBER: back off until your dog can SEE another dog, notice it, and still take a treat from you without barking or lunging.

handoffs.task_title: Week 1 — Management only: zero reactions, foundations indoors
handoffs.evidence: TRAINING, INDOORS/BACKYARD ONLY (2 x 5 min per day, evenings):

handoffs.task_title: Week 2 — Engage-Disengage stage 1 at threshold distance
handoffs.evidence: SETUP: 2-3 sessions this week of 10-15 minutes — one weeknight evening, one or two weekend mornings.

handoffs.task_title: Week 3 — Engage-Disengage stage 2, then start closing the distance
handoffs.evidence: Only reduce distance after 8/10 clean reps at the current distance.
